exact_statement: For every integer a>=0, independent Bernoulli address inputs with arbitrary probabilities q_i and independent sign data inputs of one common mean m, the Boolean addressing gate satisfies H_mu^+<=4(I_mu-Var_mu), with sharp constant 4. A disjoint read-once composition whose actual induced data-child means agree at each address node has corrected FEI+ constant max(4,C_leaf), independent of depth and fan-in. Arbitrary unrelated data means are not covered; their deterministic endpoints contain every Boolean function on the address cube.
hypotheses: Corrected entropy in bits, sigma_i^2=4q_i(1-q_i), nonempty atoms only
All input coordinates independent; distinct data variables
Common data mean at each gate under the specified actual induced law
Disjoint physical child blocks for composition
Deterministic inputs contracted before normalization; endpoints by restriction
No publication novelty or unrestricted-bias theorem asserted
proof_dependencies: Elementary biased orthonormal expansion; independently reconstructed exact disjoint composition (threshold Proposition 7.1; O Donnell-Tan Theorem 1)
